summary: The registrant filed a Form 8-K solely to disclose that its Board of Trustees declared a regular monthly dividend of $0.24 per common share, record date July 31, 2026, payable on or before August 31, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration by a specialty lending fund, not a special-situation corporate event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other transformative elements. The filing contains no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions. It is an ordinary 8-K Item 8.01 disclosure with no implications for special-situations analysis.
